title: Neonicotinoid insecticides promote breast cancer progression via G protein-coupled estrogen receptor: In vivo, in vitro and in silico studies.
authors: Li, Xin; He, Sen; Xiao, Han; He, Ting-Ting; Zhang, Jia-Da; Luo, Zi-Rui; Ma, Jie-Zhi; Yin, Yu-Long; Luo, Lin; Cao, Lin-Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新烟碱类杀虫剂通过G蛋白偶联雌激素受体促进乳腺癌进展，涉及分子对接和动力学模拟但对象为小分子-受体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neonicotinoid insecticides (NIs) have been widely detected in environmental media and human body with concentrations reaching hundreds of nanomolar to micromolar levels. However, the information about their human health toxicology and mechanism is deficient. Previous studies have implied that NIs might exert estrogenic disruption and promote breast cancer progression, but the molecular mechanism is unclear, especially the molecular initiating event. G protein-coupled estrogen receptor (GPER), as a candidate therapeutic target, plays vital roles in the development of breast cancer. This work aimed to reveal the potential mechanism through GPER pathway. Firstly, we screened the activities of seven most common NIs on GPER signal pathway by calcium mobilization assay. Clothianidin, acetamiprid (ACE), and dinotefuran activated GPER most potently and ACE displayed the highest agonistic activity with the lowest observed effective concentration (LOEC) of 1 muM. The molecular docking and dynamics simulation showed favored interaction trend between the NIs and GPER. The three NIs with GPER activity induced 4T1 breast cancer cells migration and ACE showed the highest potency with LOEC of 100 nM. ACE also induced 4T1 cells proliferation at high concentration of 50 muM and up-regulated GPER expression in a dose-dependent manner. We speculated that both the induction effects of ACE on 4T1 cells proliferation and migration might be owing to the activation and up-regulation of GPER. By using 4T1-Luc cells injected orthotopic tumor model, we found that ACE also promoted in-situ breast cancer growth and lung metastasis in normal mouse dependent on GPER. However, ACE only promoted in-situ breast cancer growth through GPER but not lung metastasis in ovariectomized mice, implying that the ACE-induced lung metastasis should be related to endogenous estrogen from ovary. Overall, we demonstrated that NIs promoted breast cancer progression via GPER pathway at human related exposure levels and their female health risks need urgent concerns.
abstract_zh: 新烟碱类杀虫剂（NIs）已在环境介质和人体中被广泛检出，浓度达到数百纳摩尔至微摩尔水平。然而，关于其人类健康毒理学及机制的信息仍不足。先前研究表明，NIs可能具有雌激素干扰作用并促进乳腺癌进展，但其分子机制尚不清楚，尤其是分子起始事件。G蛋白偶联雌激素受体（GPER）作为候选治疗靶点，在乳腺癌发展中发挥重要作用。本研究旨在通过GPER通路揭示潜在机制。首先，我们通过钙动员实验筛选了七种最常见NIs对GPER信号通路的活性。噻虫胺、啶虫脒（ACE）和呋虫胺最有效地激活了GPER，其中ACE表现出最高的激动活性，最低有效浓度（LOEC）为1微摩尔。分子对接和动力学模拟显示NIs与GPER之间存在有利的相互作用趋势。具有GPER活性的三种NIs诱导了4T1乳腺癌细胞迁移，ACE效力最高，LOEC为100纳摩尔。ACE在50微摩尔高浓度下还诱导了4T1细胞增殖，并以剂量依赖性方式上调GPER表达。我们推测ACE对4T1细胞增殖和迁移的诱导效应可能归因于GPER的激活和上调。通过使用注射4T1-Luc细胞的原位肿瘤模型，我们发现ACE在正常小鼠中也通过GPER促进了原位乳腺癌生长和肺转移。然而，在去卵巢小鼠中，ACE仅通过GPER促进原位乳腺癌生长，而未促进肺转移，这表明ACE诱导的肺转移应与卵巢来源的内源性雌激素相关。总体而言，我们证明了NIs在人类相关暴露水平下通过GPER通路促进乳腺癌进展，其对女性健康的风险亟需关注。
